sentences.en: Are you tired of choosing a cool outfit to wear for special occasions?
sentences.zh: 你厌烦为特殊场合挑选一身酷酷的装扮吗？

sentences.en: Well, now you don’t have to!
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在你不用了！

sentences.en: The all-new Trendy-wise is easy to use and you don’t have to be trendy to use it.
sentences.zh: 全新的 Trendy-wise 很好用，你也不必很时髦才能用它。

sentences.en: However, before you can use it, you have to take photos of all the clothes in your wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 不过，在使用它之前，你得把衣柜里所有衣服都拍下来。

sentences.en: And you mustn’t forget to take photos of all your shoes and socks, too.
sentences.zh: 而且千万别忘记把鞋子和袜子也拍下来。

sentences.en: Then all you have to do is click on a photo of, for example, a blue T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 然后你只要点一下某件衣服的照片，比如一件蓝色 T 恤。

sentences.en: The Trendy-wise selects photos of trousers or skirts, shoes, socks, etc., from your wardrobe to go with this T-shirt.
sentences.zh: Trendy-wise 就会从你的衣柜里挑出搭配这件 T 恤的裤子或裙子、鞋子、袜子等等的照片。

sentences.en: Each time it creates a different outfit for you and the outfits are all very trendy.
sentences.zh: 每次它都会给你搭配出不同的装扮，而且都很时髦。

sentences.en: Oh, I almost forgot!
sentences.zh: 哦，我差点忘了！

sentences.en: You also have to type in the kind of event/occasion, for example: a concert or a birthday party.
sentences.zh: 你还得输入活动的类型，比如：音乐会或生日派对。

sentences.en: Do you sometimes have bad dreams?
sentences.zh: 你有时会做噩梦吗？

sentences.en: Do you wake up scared or unhappy?
sentences.zh: 你醒来时会害怕或不开心吗？

sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 有吗？

sentences.en: Then you should buy the DreamCatcher.
sentences.zh: 那你应该买一台 DreamCatcher。

sentences.en: This is how it works:
sentences.zh: 它是这样工作的：

sentences.en: Put the machine on your head before you go to bed.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前把机器戴在头上。

sentences.en: Tell it what you want or don’t want by speaking into the microphone – for example: ‘I want dreams where I win a singing competition’ or ‘I don’t want dreams about falling.’
sentences.zh: 对着麦克风告诉它你想做什么梦、不想做什么梦——比如：“我想梦见自己赢了歌唱比赛”，或者“我不想梦见往下掉”。

sentences.en: When you are asleep, DreamCatcher will follow your dreams and make sure you get what you want.
sentences.zh: 你睡着后，DreamCatcher 会跟随你的梦，确保你梦到想要的内容。

sentences.en: Imagine that in your dream you do something dangerous.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你在梦里做了危险的事。

sentences.en: DreamCatcher will make sure you’re safe.
sentences.zh: DreamCatcher 会确保你安全。

sentences.en: Here’s an example.
sentences.zh: 举个例子。

sentences.en: Let’s say you start to climb a high mountain.
sentences.zh: 假设你开始爬一座高山。

sentences.en: You don’t have to worry because the DreamCatcher will make you walk back down again.
sentences.zh: 你不用担心，因为 DreamCatcher 会让你往回走下山。

sentences.en: But you mustn’t use the machine every night.
sentences.zh: 但你不能每晚都用这台机器。

sentences.en: It will only work every three days.
sentences.zh: 它每三天才起作用一次。
